diagnostics.message: `google_project_iam_member.additive` grants roles from `var.iam_additive_roles`, which may reference custom roles created in this module by `google_project_iam_custom_role.roles`. Since `role` is a plain string from a variable, Terraform cannot infer this ordering, and applying an additive binding before its custom role exists fails with a "role not found" error. The module already guards the analogous authoritative binding (`google_project_iam_binding.authoritative`) with an explicit `depends_on` on the custom roles, but the additive bindings lack the same protection. Add `depends_on = [google_project_iam_custom_role.roles]` to `google_project_iam_member.additive`.
